title: Associations between dietary intake of mitochondria-related nutrients with the risk of migraine: a prospective study of 202,656 participants
venue: The Journal of Headache and Pain
abstract: Higher dietary intake of mitochondrial-related nutrients was associated with a reduced risk of migraine, with niacin and vitamin B12 showing the most stable protective effects. Our study suggests that adjusting dietary intake of mitochondria-related nutrients may offer a promising strategy for the prevention and management of migraine.
